## What is publicly documented

::: {.case-evidence}
The BIA Ute Mountain Ute Agency lists forestry and fire-management branches. This establishes an agency context, although that might not be the Tribe’s preferred research agenda.
:::

Sources: [Bureau of Indian Affairs: Ute Mountain Ute Agency](https://www.bia.gov/regional-offices/southwest/ute-mountain-ute-agency). Reviewed October 14, 2026.


## A proposed question to discuss

Which woodland, fuels, resource-use or community-protection questions would the Tribe want a synthesis team to support?

This question was drafted for the prototype.

## A possible learning contribution

Ask the Tribe which existing programs and priorities should shape a case.

## What remains context-specific

Do not infer Tribal staffing, capacity, priorities or governance from the federal agency listing.
